title: Custom cleaners
description: Build local file-cleaning rules with a preview before you enable or run them.
localPrivacy: Free and local. Definitions and exports include absolute folder paths. Imports are always disabled until you preview and enable them; no subscription is required.
name: Name
folderSafety: Choose a specific data or cache subfolder. System folders, profile roots, Kudu data, credential folders, aliases and junctions are protected. Only regular files are eligible; directories are never removed.
patternHelp: One value per line. Filename patterns support * and ? only, such as *.tmp or cache-*.log. Folder exclusions use relative paths such as keep or sessions/current. No commands, regex or directory wildcards.
enableHelp: Enabled rules appear under Apps in normal cleaner scans, including scheduled App cleaning. Global exclusions and recent-file protection still apply. Review the contents carefully before enabling.
manualHelp: Preview a single rule definition here. Save only after the preview completes. Import/export files wrap definitions in {version: 1, rules: [...]}.
qualification: Listed files match {{patterns}}, are at least {{days}} days old, and pass current exclusions and recent-file protection.
previewLimits: A preview expires after ten minutes and is limited to 2,000 matches, 50,000 inspected entries and ten seconds. Incomplete previews cannot enable or run a cleaner. Each file is checked again just before deletion; changed files are skipped.
confirmClean: Permanently delete the {{count}} previewed files ({{size}}) for {{name}}? This cannot be undone. Files created or changed since preview will not be included.
confirmDelete: Delete the definition for {{name}}? This does not delete any files from its folder.
issues: Some items could not be cleaned. First 100 reported issues:
imported: Imported {{count}} disabled definitions. Review their folders before enabling.
